name: avc
description: Snapshot, diff, branch, and merge your projects — version control built for AI agents.
long_description: AVC gives Claude the ability to review and recover your work: see what agents changed session by session, diff any two points in time, and roll back when something breaks. Point it at the folders your projects live in.

project_folders.title: Project folders
project_folders.description: Folders to search for AVC projects, such as your code directory. AVC looks up to four levels deep. A folder that is not an AVC project yet can be set up from the conversation.
